# Orange Logic Appoints Ben Colenso as Managing Director, EMEA

![](https://www.orangelogic.com/hubfs/Screenshot%202026-10-22%20at%208.17.36%20PM.png)

Quick Takeaways

- Orange Logic has appointed Ben Colenso as Managing Director, EMEA. He is based in the UK.
- Colenso brings 20 years of experience in technology and media production, most recently leading technology strategy at Hogarth, WPP's content experience company.
- He will lead regional strategy, customer enablement, and market expansion for an EMEA customer base that includes ITV, Pearson, GSK, Ubisoft, and Tourism Ireland.

_Strategic hire underscores company's growth and commitment to the region_

**Irvine, CA — June 5th, 2025** — Orange Logic, the leader in digital asset management and content orchestration, today announced the appointment of Ben Colenso as Managing Director for EMEA. Based in the UK, Colenso will spearhead Orange Logic's regional strategy, customer enablement, and market expansion efforts, as the company accelerates its global footprint.

Colenso brings 20 years of experience in technology and media production, having most recently led the technology strategy for Hogarth, WPP's content experience company. Known for solving complex problems for some of the world's most iconic brands with his customer-centric approach, Colenso will play a critical role in strengthening Orange Logic's presence and partnerships across EMEA which span customers such as ITV, Pearson, GSK, Ubisoft and Tourism Ireland amongst others.

"I'm thrilled to join Orange Logic at such an exciting time in its journey," said Colenso. "The company's vision, product depth, and customer focus are second to none, and I look forward to working closely with our clients and teams to unlock even more value across the region."

The appointment comes on the heels of Orange Logic's continued investment in international growth and innovation, following its expanded platform capabilities in content orchestration and AI-powered workflows. With clients across media, healthcare, finance, and cultural institutions, Orange Logic is helping organizations manage complexity, streamline operations, and scale content at speed.

## **FAQs: Ben Colenso's Appointment**

#### Who is Orange Logic's Managing Director for EMEA?

Ben Colenso was appointed Managing Director, EMEA on June 5, 2025. Based in the UK, he leads Orange Logic's regional strategy, customer enablement, and market expansion.

#### What experience does Ben Colenso bring to the role?

Colenso has 20 years of experience in technology and media production. Most recently, he led technology strategy for Hogarth, WPP's content experience company, solving complex problems for some of the world's best-known brands.

#### Which EMEA customers does Orange Logic work with?

Orange Logic's customers in the region include ITV, Pearson, GSK, Ubisoft, and Tourism Ireland, among others.

#### Why is Orange Logic investing in EMEA?

Orange Logic continues to see strong momentum and growing demand from sophisticated enterprises in EMEA. The appointment follows the company's continued investment in international growth, content orchestration, and AI-powered workflows.
